title: All-in-one: Understanding and Generation in Multimodal Reasoning with the MAIA Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) using text-only (unimodal) and black-video baselines to measure their reliance on the statistical distribution of text and language priors rather than actual visual grounding.
Comparing model performance on tasks using full 32-frame video inputs versus a 1-frame baseline to assess the models' reliance on static visual features instead of full spatio-temporal reasoning.
